newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's UDC to buy out all of Truck Leasing Ltd.
newsitem.headline: NZ's UDC to buy out all of Truck Leasing Ltd.

text.p: New Zealand finance company UDC said on Wednesday it would buy out the country's leading truck leasing company, Truck Leasing Ltd.
UDC already owns 80 percent of the company.

"The move follows UDC's move to 100 percent ownership of Avis Lease in November 1995, giving it full ownership of the country's leading motor vehicle and truck leasing operations," UDC said in a statement.
The terms of the purchase are currently being negotiated.

UDC is the largest financier of heavy vehicles in New Zealand, with around 20 percent of its NZ$1.73 billion in assets invested in the sector. The company is due shortly to restate its assets when it announces its result for the year to September 30.
Truck Leasing Ltd specialises in providing fully maintained operating leases on heavy vehicles and has a fleet of more than 700 heavy trucks operating around the country.
UDC spokeswoman Linda McGregor said the company hoped to complete the purchase by December 20. The purchase price was subject to negotiation.
